source: Official MIT Lab4 Unity 2019.3.9f1, native x86_64, hardware OpenGL via D3D12 / NVIDIA RTX 4060; ROS1 Noetic via PRoot
trajectory: minimum snap; z solved separately with zero vertical velocity at gates; per-segment time allocation to |v|<=8 m/s, |a|<=6 m/s^2, |a_z|<=5 m/s^2 within a 0.5 m corridor of the uniform-time path; reference sampled at each state stamp
collisions: Floor_01 only (takeoff from the floor); no wall, ceiling or gate colliders
metric_note: unity_flight.csv rebuilt from the rosbag by scripts/rebuild_flight_csv.py: each state is paired with the reference sampled at its own time. The live monitor CSV (unity_flight_monitor.csv) mis-aligned the reference. High-frequency tilt = roll/pitch minus a 0.5 s Savitzky-Golay fit.
gate_colours: Fresh Unity player: every gate is red until the drone flies through it in this run. scripts/run_unity_race.sh refuses a second recording on the same player.
